title: A run at Tue 08:59:59 UTC settles the week before
description: Before the 09:00 cut-off the job settles [26 Oct, 2 Nov). A task from 30 Oct is paid; one from 4 Nov waits for next week. DEF-005. Buggy: the run is treated as due from Tuesday 00:00, so it settles 2-9 Nov and pays T-022 instead of T-021.
